NYT.take: NYT: it is bouncing inside a downtrend; the buy waits for a daily close above the Aug 26 high, the first sign the decline is over. Selling is losing force (weekly), and MACD is positive. Against it, the weekly chart is in its declining stage. The desk stays out until the trigger's close says otherwise.
NYT.change: Until a daily close above +0.4%, the decline is intact and there is no trade; once in, a daily close below −3.1%, under the 61.8% retracement of the Sep 15–Oct 2 drop, proves it wrong. The case against, that the weekly chart is in its declining stage, fails on a weekly close above +4%, the 30-week average.
